tweener: Blend values between the previous and next keys.
tweener_worldspace: Blend transforms between neighboring poses in world space.
blend_to_buffer: Blend the current pose toward the stored pose buffer.
blend_to_default: Blend channels toward their default values.
blend_to_ease: Blend the current values toward an eased interpolation.
blend_to_frame: Blend toward values sampled from picked reference frames.
blend_to_frame_ws: Blend toward picked reference frames in world space.
blend_to_neighbors: Blend toward the previous or next neighboring key.
blend_to_neighbors_ws: Blend toward neighboring poses in world space.
blend_to_infinity: Blend toward the curve's pre-infinity or post-infinity value.
blend_to_infinity_ws: Blend toward infinity values in world space.
blend_to_undo: Blend back toward the state captured before this interaction.
